title: Avuvram

paragraphs: Chullin 38a: Ravina said, “Sama bar Chilkai told me: the father of bar Avuvram raised an objection to this.” Rashi explains that this is Avuvram himself: people knew the son but not the father, so they called the father by his son’s name. Some say instead, “the brother of bar Avuvram.”
